entities.summary: Quintus Cervidius Scaevola was a Roman jurist of the equestrian order. Both the Historia Augusta and the Tabula Banasitana attest that Scaevola was a member of Marcus Aurelius's consilium or inner circle of advisors. Except that Papinian was his student, little more is known of Scaevola's life.
